survey: A classic straw broom shown diagonally on a plain wavy blue background, with the handle going to the upper right and the head to the lower left. The straight wooden handle ends at the top in a rounded knob cap. At the bottom it goes into a yellow straw collar where the bristles are gathered. Two red braided bands wrap tightly around the collar, binding the straw to the handle. Below the bindings the straw fans out into a flared, rounded head with even strands. The broom is an icon floating on an abstract background with no ground surface, so it needs no support. The handle meets the head on the same axis, the bindings close around the collar with no loose ends, and the parts don't pass through each other. The broom could sweep as drawn.
